profile.headline: BBA (Entrepreneurship) Student
profile.introduction: I am a BBA student at IIM Udaipur with a strong interest in business strategy, finance and entrepreneurship. I enjoy exploring business challenges, participating in case competitions and developing practical skills in research, analytical thinking, communication and problem-solving.

about.heading: Building analytical rigor through strategy, finance, and real-world case challenges.
about.leadQuote: Committed to disciplined business thinking, clear communication, and continuous growth.
paragraphs: As an undergraduate student pursuing the Bachelor of Business Administration (Entrepreneurship) at the Indian Institute of Management Udaipur, my academic journey is anchored in understanding how enduring businesses are designed, financed, and scaled.

My primary interests span business strategy, corporate and market finance, and entrepreneurship. Rather than approaching business concepts solely in theory, I actively test and sharpen my reasoning by participating in national-level case competitions and business quizzes hosted across premier management and technical institutes.

Alongside my academic coursework, I am deeply curious about early-stage startups, structured business research, and operational execution. I believe that strong problem-solving stems from asking sharper questions, working collaboratively within diverse teams, and staying committed to continuous learning and professional development.
